name: Petit Four
source:
The protagonist Kanzaki Mei is a 3rd year high school student who loves cooking.
Her future dream is to work at her grandfather's small French restaurant. 

One day, her grandfather becomes ill and had to be hospitalized, the restaurant was in danger of being closed. 
The protagonist's parents weren't' interested in running a restaurant and were planning to sell it and the land, but her grandfather entrusted the restaurant to Mei.

Mei loves her grandfathers cooking and the restaurant, so she started up plans to take over the restaurant during the summer break.
But most of the staff quit and the only ones left were the floor manager and an uninvited chef.
The protagonist's job starts with finding talented staff to help out.

With a talented but stubborn chef, a sommelier who's only good side is his sense of taste, an inflexible manager, a classmate whose only worth is his enthusiasm, and an upperclassman with a trivial attitude, the staff are all problem children.
Will the protagonist be able to successfully reclaim the fame of her grandfather's restaurant over the summer break while dealing with these guys?

[Translated from [url=http://www.otomate.jp/home/game/spec/?hard=ps2&title=petit]the official site[/url]]
translation:
主人公神崎芽衣是一名热爱烹饪的高中三年级学生。
她未来的梦想是在祖父经营的小型法式餐厅工作。

一天，祖父病倒住院，餐厅也面临关闭危机。
主人公的父母对经营餐厅毫无兴趣，原本打算卖掉店铺和土地，但祖父却把餐厅托付给了芽衣。

芽衣热爱祖父的料理和这家餐厅，于是决定在暑假期间接手经营。
然而，大多数员工都已辞职，只剩下大堂经理和一名不请自来的厨师。
主人公的第一项任务，便是寻找有能力的员工前来帮忙。

才华横溢却性格固执的厨师、优点只有味觉的侍酒师、不知变通的经理、唯一可取之处就是热情的同学，以及态度轻浮的学长——这些员工个个都是问题人物。
芽衣能否在暑假期间与他们相处，并成功恢复祖父餐厅昔日的声誉？

[翻译自[url=http://www.otomate.jp/home/game/spec/?hard=ps2&title=petit]官方网站[/url]]
